contactSub: Have an idea, project or role in mind? Tell me about it — I read every message myself.
heroSub: I design interfaces for insurance, fintech, logistics and e-commerce products — the kind of complexity most people never see, made simple to use.
aboutParagraphs: I'm Vitaly, a UX/UI and product designer who cares more about whether something works than whether it looks clever. Most of my work sits in domains people don't love thinking about — insurance, logistics, currency, HR — which is exactly why the interface has to do the thinking for them.
I blend strategy, research and craft to take a product from a messy problem to something people trust on the first try.
aboutHeading: Crafting systems that hold up under real use.

capabilities.title: Visual Systems
capabilities.text: I build interfaces that hold together: reusable components, clear hierarchy, and typography that makes a product feel considered before anyone reads a word.

capabilities.title: Product Thinking
capabilities.text: I turn ambiguous problems into shippable products — balancing user needs, business goals and engineering constraints into one direction.

capabilities.title: User Experience
capabilities.text: Good UX disappears. I use research and prototyping to make interactions feel obvious, whether it's a trading app or an internal ops tool.

capabilities.title: Research & Iteration
capabilities.text: I test assumptions against real behavior, not opinions, and keep refining after launch — not just before it.
